argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$t=Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing 'http://127.0.0.1:17410/json/list' -TimeoutSec 3
$target=@($t)|Where-Object { try { ([uri]$_.url).Host -eq 'bugbountyfoto6.files.com' } catch { $false } } | Select-Object -First 1
$ws=[System.Net.WebSockets.ClientWebSocket]::new(); $cts=[System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource]::new(); $cts.CancelAfter(6000)
$ws.ConnectAsync([uri]$target.webSocketDebuggerUrl,$cts.Token).GetAwaiter().GetResult() | Out-Null
$expr=@'
JSON.stringify([...document.querySelectorAll('button,a')].map((e,i)=>({i,text:(e.innerText||e.getAttribute('aria-label')||'').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,120),tag:e.tagName,disabled:!!e.disabled,href:e.tagName==='A'?(new URL(e.href,location.href).pathname):null})).filter(x=>x.text).slice(0,120))
'@
$payload=@{id=1;method='Runtime.evaluate';params=@{expression=$expr;returnByValue=$true}}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress
$bytes=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($payload)
$ws.SendAsync([ArraySegment[byte]]::new($bytes),[Net.WebSockets.WebSocketMessageType]::Text,$true,$cts.Token).GetAwaiter().GetResult() | Out-Null
$buf=New-Object byte[] 131072
while($true){$ms=[IO.MemoryStream]::new();do{$r=$ws.ReceiveAsync([ArraySegment[byte]]::new($buf),$cts.Token).GetAwaiter().GetResult();if($r.Count){$ms.Write($buf,0,$r.Count)}}while(-not $r.EndOfMessage);$o=([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($ms.ToArray())|ConvertFrom-Json);if($o.id -eq 1){Write-Output $o.result.result.value;break}}
$ws.Dispose()

note: Read-only DOM inventory of Files.com actions in tetst1 public-b page; no credentials or headers inspected
